propositions: A `recheck-review` Gerrit comment must trigger a forced re-review for coverage-gap sub-reasons and other non-finding LLM-Review -1 verdicts, but refuse re-review when the current revision carries a real-finding BLOCK tag

The eligibility precheck must read the bot's persisted current-revision vote message from Gerrit (via GET /a/changes/{id}/messages) and parse the tag by stem, stripping trailing (merge-change, …) suffix to classify all production tag shapes including merge-review and merge-change variants
On acceptance, the trigger must reset the 0347 retry-attempts budget via dedup.reset_attempts() and enqueue with _rebar_force, posting a message-only reply (no labels key in the Gerrit REST body)
On refusal of a real-finding BLOCK, the trigger must post a reply comment explaining the finding must be fixed and re-pushed, emit RETRIGGER_REFUSED, and perform no enqueue or budget reset
Comments authored by the bot itself and comments without the `recheck-review` token must be silently ignored (no reply, no action)
The webhooks.config must add comment-added event subscription, and infra/gerrit/service-user.sh must be re-run by an operator to activate the trigger before it receives events
